prompt: If the person who played the joker in "The Dark Knight" (2008) had children, how old will they be on the films 50th anniversary?
answer:
Heath Ledger, who played the Joker, had one child: **Matilda Rose Ledger**, born on **October 28, 2005**.

*The Dark Knight* was released on **July 18, 2008**, so its 50th anniversary will be **July 18, 2058**. Matilda will then be **52 years old**.
